Description: A reward from Vicecanon Servyna for helping One-Eye end the Dominion's trading in Shadowfen.
These boots have a thin coating of foul-smelling mucus.

Item Name: You cured Mozgosh, fulfilling her father's dying wish. In return, she gifted you these sturdy greaves.
Lamia's Boon of the Three Sisters
Description: A gift from the Nereids of Arx Corinium.
These leggings are soft yet durable.
This ring causes pain in the hand it is worn upon.

Item Name: A priestess of Arkay thanked you with this fiery staff after you brought her a cursed Daedric urn from the ruins of Broken Tusk.

Description: Nabbed by Prowls-in-Stealth from the Dominion soldiers who killed his people after you helped exact his revenge.
The blade of this axe is jagged and sharp.

Item Name: Shield of the Third House of Hist Sap
Description: This shield bears an inscrutable insignia.

Item Name: After a few shocking events, you earned this ring for helping Gathotar catch wamasu lightning.

Description: A fine axe awarded for dispersing the illusions of the wispmother that posed as Valrendil's wife.
Bequeathed by Tree-Minder for returning her tribe to the Hist after they were slaughtered by the Dominion.
This staff is soaked with acrid swamp water.

Item Name: A helm fit for ruin-rummaging. Zahra gave it to you after you helped her nab the Crown of Ascension.

Description: Vicecanon Servyna gave you these gloves for saving the eggs at the Hatching Pools in Shadowfen.

Item Name: Bestowed by the Keeper of the Shell after you uncovered a Dominion poultice that destroys Hist trees.
Erranenen thanked you with this ring for winning back his prized lute in a game of riddles at the Hatching Pools.

Description: This dagger is made from a single jagged tooth.
Awarded for successfully completing the Trials of the Burnished Scales in Shadowfen.

Item Name: Kamax-Ei entrusted this dagger to you after you saved Hissmir from being captured by the Dominion.

Description: This necklace oozes with the primordial power of the Hist.

Item Name: Left behind by the spirit of an Ayleid Knight in Loriasel after you helped him find peace.

Description: Gifted for quelling the rampaging Goblins at Mud Tree Mine and rescuing the miners trapped inside.
The Shadowscales gave you this excellent bow for helping them take back Murkwater from Dominion pillagers.

Item Name: Dessicated Belt of the Hatchling's Shell
Description: This belt creaks when bent.
This dagger looks to be made from the pincher of a giant insect.
Gifted by Ja-Reet for untangling the knots within his spirit and connecting him to the Hist.

Item Name: The ring of a father who lost his son to the Dominion but found peace in his return to the Hist.

Description: You earned these boots while ruby hunting in Shadowfen's murky swamps. And the stomachs of its beasts.

Item Name: Awarded for helping the slave, Suriel, find belongings in hiding spots she'd forgotten.
Bestowed by Imperials for helping clear the poison gas they dumped in Shadowfen's swamps.

Description: This necklace seems to draw life energy from the very space around it.

Item Name: Discarded Bonds of the Hatchling's Shell
Description: These metal bonds are strong but restricting.

Item Name: A versatile belt you earned by slaying Shadowfen beasts in an effort to complete a drunken bet between friends.
Left behind to buy your silence by an Argonian merchant who spread too many rumors.

Description: You earned this cursed dagger by seeing to the recovery of the second Fang of Sithis at Sunscale Strand.
Grisly as it may be, these leggings are made from several different types of skin stitched together.
Bestowed by the merchant Daeril for releasing the spirits of his companions, confined in crystals by the Worm Cult.
Passed on by Erranza for burying her remains with her children outside White Rose Prison.
A parting gift from Tree-Minder Nexith after you helped him get rid of the Daedric Miasma in Xal Ithix.

Item Name: A belt that fastens nicely. Secured from Nimble-Knuckles for dealing with the strangler situation at Xal Ithix.
Slimy Acidic Staff of the Hatchling's Shell
Description: This staff is covered in goo.
Rewarded for uncovering the truth behind the last Kothringi and the missing keystone at Zuuk.

Item Name: A fine helm bequeathed by Drillk, supposedly the last Kothringi. That isn't the way he sees things, though.
